subject: Barrel Spin
author: Xandu
body:
It's really cool and I do it pretty much all the time as long as I have enough speed and the jump is going to be high enough.

I do it pretty much all the time. Got myself a 6x multiplier of one jump in stunt run doing it to day. Barrel Roll + 2x Flat spin + Super Jump + Air Time (2 + 2 + 1 + 1).

-- The Creator --
